sections.title: Treatment records
sections.sql: select * from treatment_register where mob=(select name from mobs where id=$1)
sections.note: Label directions and veterinary advice govern actual treatment. Demonstration intervals are fictional.

sections.title: Livestock
sections.sql: select s.* from mob_summary s join mobs m on m.id=s.id join paddocks p on p.id=m.paddock_id where p.farm_id=$1

sections.title: Treatment register
sections.sql: select t.* from treatment_register t join treatments r on r.id=t.id join mobs m on m.id=r.mob_id join paddocks p on p.id=m.paddock_id where p.farm_id=$1
sections.note: A working record for the operator and auditor. It does not certify accreditation or replace source documents.
